map.根据房间面积与照度要求，计算所需灯具数量与总功率。: Computes the number of fixtures and total power by room area and illuminance.
map.💡 总光通量 = 照度 × 面积 ÷ (CU × MF)；灯具数量 = 总光通量: Total flux = illuminance x area / (CU x MF); fixture count = total flux / (lamp power x efficacy); total power = count x lamp power.
map.利用系数 CU 取决于房间形状、反射率与灯具配光，一般 0.4-0.7: CU depends on room shape, reflectance and luminaire distribution, typically 0.4-0.7.
map.维护系数 MF 反映光衰与积灰，洁净空间 0.8，一般 0.7: MF reflects lumen decay and dust; clean space 0.8, general 0.7.
map.功率密度宜控制在国标限值内（办公约 ≤9 W/m²，住宅 ≤7 W/m²）: Power density should stay within national limits (office ~<=9 W/m2, residential <=7 W/m2).
map.书房按 300–500lux 目标，用面积×照度得总流明，再除以单灯流明得灯数，: For a study at 300-500lux, area x illuminance gives total lumens, divided by per-lamp lumens gives count, avoiding too dim or harsh.
map.车间/厨房等高照度场所按 500–750lux 核算，确认现有灯具功率是否够，防: For workshops/kitchens at 500-750lux, verify existing lamp power is enough to prevent low task illuminance.
map.替换 LED 时，用『总流明需求』反推新灯功率（LED 约 100lm/W），比: When switching to LED, back-calc new lamp power from total lumen need (LED ~100lm/W); more accurate than reading watts.
map.面积 12㎡，目标 400lux\n总光通 = 12 × 400 = 4800:
Area 12 m2, target 400lux
Total flux = 12 x 400 = 4800 lm
LED~100lm/W -> ~48W, split 2-3 fixtures evenly
map.lux 是照度（落地的光），瓦数是耗电；中间靠光效 lm/W 连接。LED 光效: Lux is illuminance (light on surface), watts is power; they link via lm/W efficacy. LED has high efficacy, far fewer watts than incandescent at same lumens.
map.未计利用系数（光被吸收）与维护系数（积灰衰减），实际需乘 1.2–1.5 余量；: Utilization (absorption) and maintenance (dust decay) factors were not counted; add 1.2-1.5 margin; dark walls and high ceilings also absorb light.
map.起居 100–200、书房 300–500、厨房操作台 500–750、走廊 5: Living 100-200, study 300-500, kitchen bench 500-750, corridor 50-100 (lux); follow GB 50034.
map.基于流明法（平均照度法）计算房间所需灯具数量与总功率，内置多种灯具光效与典型照度: Based on the lumen method (average illuminance), computes fixture count and total power, with built-in lamp efficacy and typical standards, aiding lighting design and energy check.
